summary: @ornikar/storybook-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which fetches the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes a bundled 727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS file `math_init.js` under that freshly downloaded runtime via `execFileSync`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXXXX` identifier mangling in setup.mjs; a single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with rotating string-array decoding in math_init.js). The stated purpose of the package is Storybook configuration, which has no need for an alternate JS runtime or an opaque install-time payload, and prior releases of this package shipped neither. Installing this version causes arbitrary attacker-authored code to execute on the installer's host at `npm install` time under a runtime that bypasses Node-based instrumentation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
